_help: Paid Featured roles. Add one block per advertiser and push. It shows (with a 'Sponsored' label) at the top of the homepage and the All roles page until the 'until' date, then disappears by itself. 'id' = short lowercase name with no spaces (used for click counts: Cloudflare > Observability, search apply_click and the id). 'url' must be the advertiser's own https application page.
